hide-new-icons.description: Send new tray icons to the overflow automatically (like Windows 11)
hide-new-icons.tooltip: When on, every icon you haven't decided about yet goes into the ^ popup. Pin the ones you want in the panel.

show-count.description: Show the number of hidden icons next to it

open-on-hover.description: Open the popup when the mouse is over the button
open-on-hover.tooltip: The popup closes again when the mouse leaves it (not while an app's menu from the popup is open).

close-delay.description: Delay before closing when the mouse leaves

head-attention.description: Icons that come back when they change

attention-delay-in.description: Wait before moving an icon into the panel
attention-delay-in.tooltip: The new look must stay this long. 0 = immediately.

attention-delay-out.description: Wait before moving it back to the overflow
attention-delay-out.tooltip: Prevents flickering when an app briefly shows its normal icon in between.

show-list-in-popup.description: Show "Icons shown in the panel" in the popup
show-list-in-popup.tooltip: When off, the popup only shows the hidden icons. The list is always available by right-clicking the button.

debug-log.description: Write details to the log (Looking Glass)
debug-log.tooltip: Logs which app each tray icon belongs to and when icons move. Useful for bug reports.

show-all-button.description: Show all icons in the panel again
